tasks.gr9-business-responsibility-integration-: Topic: Business responsibility and integration. Cover labour responsibility (wages, working conditions, legal rights), corporate social responsibility, business ethics, South African labour law, responsibilities to employees, customers and society. Ask Grade 9 learners to assess business responsibility, analyse labour law compliance, identify stakeholder impacts, evaluate ethical decisions, and explain CSR integration into business strategy.
tasks.gr9-exam-revision-preparation-t4: Topic: Exam revision and preparation. Cover case study analysis, concept integration across all terms, exam strategies (time management, reading questions, defining terms, justifying answers, providing evidence). Ask Grade 9 learners to analyse complex case studies, apply multiple concepts, justify integrated business decisions, use examples effectively, and demonstrate mastery across economic systems, entrepreneurship, financials, marketing and responsibility.
tasks.gr9-cash-credit-trial-balance-t4: Topic: Cash and credit transactions with the trial balance for Grade 9 EMS (CAPS term 4). Cover analysing cash and credit transactions into debit and credit entries (capital, cash sales, credit sales, credit purchases, expenses paid, receipts from debtors, payments to creditors), posting to ledger accounts, finding balances and their sides, and drawing up a trial balance whose debit and credit columns agree; also what a difference shows and that a balancing trial balance does not prove that every amount is correct. Every amount must be worked out from the transactions shown. No VAT.
tasks.gr9-business-plan-swot-t4: Topic: The business plan: format and SWOT. Cover the concept of a business plan, its format (front cover, table of contents, description of the product or service, goals, the business owner, production plan, marketing plan, management plan, SWOT analysis, conclusion), what each plan says, clear and measurable goals, and the SWOT analysis (strengths and weaknesses are inside the business, opportunities and threats are outside it; strengths and opportunities help, weaknesses and threats harm). Use made-up businesses only. Ask Grade 9 learners to order the parts, say what a part contains and classify statements as strengths, weaknesses, opportunities or threats.
tasks.gr9-financial-plan-t4: Topic: The financial plan: costs, break-even and mark-up. Cover fixed and variable costs and total costs, the break-even point = fixed costs / (selling price - variable cost per item) rounded up to a whole item, mark-up in rand and as a percentage of cost price ((selling price - cost price) / cost price x 100), the selling price from a mark-up percentage on cost price, and profit percentage = profit / sales x 100. Use whole-rand amounts and made-up businesses (a candle stall, a shop buying a bag or shoes). Ask Grade 9 learners to classify costs and calculate break-even, mark-up, selling price and profit percentage.
